title: Telvaro AG
subtitle: A new supplier, checked before signing
note: Telvaro AG is an invented name standing in for a well-known Swiss company checked in a real run; names and numbers are replaced, the findings are not, and nothing is alleged. Every finding is an Antevo engine's answer on the date shown, from public records.

tries.label: Check by check
tries.source: Antevo Companies, Antevo Guard and Antevo Trademark, 25 Nov 2026 · Zefix, SHAB, GLEIF, OFAC, EU, UK and SECO sanctions lists, certificate logs and public DNS

items.name: Is it who it says it is?
evidence: Telvaro AG, canton Bern: active in the Swiss commercial register
An LEI issued to Telvaro AG, next renewal 22 July 2027

items.name: Is it on a sanctions list?
evidence: Not found under its name or identifiers on the OFAC, EU, UK and SECO lists, read 23 to 24 November 2026
Not being listed is not the same as unrestricted: ownership by a listed party needs its own check

items.name: Do the website and email add up?
evidence: Its domain: first certificate logged 6 March 2008
It points to a web server, not a parking page; nothing in five sources contradicts the record

items.name: What changed lately?
evidence: Signatories changed on 6 May 2026 (two in, one out) and on 30 June 2026 (one in)
23 register notices since 2019, the auditor changed in 2019

items.name: Which company signs?
evidence: Several Swiss companies carry the name: Telvaro Services AG, Telvaro Fixnet AG, Telvaro Ventures AG and more
The trademarks sit with Telvaro (Schweiz) AG: 17 marks, all registered, filing since 1996

steps.label: Before you sign, with the links

items.do: Get today's register extract and check who may sign
items.why: Signatories changed twice this year; the person signing should be on today's extract.

items.do: Make the contract and the invoice name the same company, with its UID
items.why: Several group companies share the name; the UID settles which one you deal with.

items.do: Confirm the bank details on a phone number you already hold
items.why: Public records cannot see who owns a bank account; a call can.

items.do: If your rules require it, run your own sanctions check
items.why: This read is not a compliance screen; the official search is free.
A file is today only; at most one alert a day if the register or a sanctions list changes.

sections.title: Who is behind it
sections.so_what: If your onboarding needs owners, ask for the beneficial-owner declaration.
evidence: GLEIF lists no parent: no person or company is known to control it
Owners who are people are not public in Switzerland; 10 corporate holders by identifier are on file
sections.source: Antevo Companies, 25 Nov 2026 (GLEIF, SEC filings, PermID)

sections.title: Its brand
sections.so_what: The names you see on the invoice are its own: no sign of a borrowed brand.
evidence: Telvaro (Schweiz) AG holds 17 marks in Switzerland, Canada, Singapore and internationally, none abandoned
Most claims in classes 9, 38 and 42; last filing 25 August 2026

sections.title: Its market today
sections.so_what: For a multi-year cloud or data-centre contract, ask how prices are fixed if funding gets dearer.
evidence: AI-linked funding strain could make funding dearer for data-centre owners and cloud providers (high impact, medium likelihood, rising)
Nothing on the board names Swiss telecoms directly

links.text: The register shows several companies under the name, and the trademark book shows which one holds the brand: the contract should say which one you deal with.
The register, the LEI and the website all point to the same company, so the remaining checks are people and paper: who signs, and which account is paid.
